description: The Go standard library net/http server with no framework, default configuration. Routing through the ServeMux method and wildcard patterns of Go 1.22, JSON through encoding/json, gzip written by hand with compress/gzip because the standard library ships no compression middleware. HTTP/2 is net/http's own: over TLS through ALPN on 8443, and with prior knowledge on 8082 through http.Server.Protocols.
